cases.title: An undone demo, redone by the learner, is credited to the learner

rubric.reason: In Turn 4, where the check shows demo_credit "learner_after_undo" and eased_by_learner, the mentor credits the learner: "the Position move from 0.5 s to 1.5 s, which you redid yourself after undoing my demo, so the whole layer is your work"; in Turn 3 the pair was still linear, so it correctly gave no credit yet.
